__inputs.name: DS_TRINO
__inputs.label: Trino
__inputs.description: Trino-Datasource der Plattform (Katalog postgresql-web-ui, Schema afzs_fulda)

description: Automatische Fahrgastzählung (Strabag APC, Rhönenergie): Ein-/Aussteiger, Besetzung, Haltestellen, Türen und Datenqualität aus den Tabellen des apc-importers (Variable Schema, in der Plattform "postgresql-web-ui".afzs_fulda über Trino). Quelle: tenant-eichenzell grafana/dashboards/component-apc.json.

panels.title: Events
panels.description: Türschließ-Events (eine XML = ein Event) im Zeitraum für die gewählten Fahrzeuge/Linien.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Einsteiger
panels.description: Summe aller gültigen Einsteiger (alle Türen, alle Klassen).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(sum(boarding_total), 0) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Aussteiger
panels.description: Summe aller gültigen Aussteiger.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(sum(alighting_total), 0) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Fahrzeuge
panels.description: Fahrzeuge, von denen im Zeitraum mindestens ein Event kam.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(DISTINCT vehicle_id) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Ungültige Events
panels.description: Events mit negativen oder nicht-numerischen Zählwerten (`valid = false`). Sollte 0 sein.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND NOT valid

panels.title: Letztes Event
panels.description: Sekunden seit dem letzten Event der ausgewählten Fahrzeuge (unabhängig von Zeitbereich und Linie).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT min(age_seconds) FROM ${schema}.v_vehicle_status WHERE vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring})

panels.title: Ein- / Aussteiger pro Stunde
panels.description: Aussteiger sind zur besseren Lesbarkeit nach unten aufgetragen.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_ts) AS time,
       sum(boarding_total)   AS "Einsteiger",
       -sum(alighting_total) AS "Aussteiger"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Besetzung pro Fahrzeug
panels.description: Kumulierte Besetzung (Ein- minus Aussteiger) je Fahrzeug und Betriebstag. Negative Werte bedeuten: mehr Aussteiger gezählt als je eingestiegen – Zählung unvollständig oder Sensor driftet.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT event_ts AS time, vehicle_id AS metric, occupancy AS value
FROM ${schema}.v_occupancy
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fahrgäste pro Tag nach Klasse
panels.description: Einsteiger pro Betriebstag, aufgeteilt nach ObjectClass (Adult, Child, Bike, …).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('day', e.event_ts) AS time, c.object_class AS metric, sum(c.boarding) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.boarding IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Events pro Fahrzeug und Stunde
panels.description: Wie viele Türschließungen jedes Fahrzeug pro Stunde meldet. Ein Fahrzeug, das im Betrieb auf 0 fällt, sendet nicht mehr (SFTP, Gerät, Netz).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', event_ts) AS time, vehicle_id AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top-Haltestellen nach Einsteigern
panels.description: Die 15 Haltestellen mit den meisten Einsteigern im Zeitraum.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?') AS "Haltestelle", sum(boarding_total) AS "Einsteiger", sum(alighting_total) AS "Aussteiger"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Haltestellen-Karte
panels.description: Haltestellen aus den GNSS-Positionen der Events, Größe und Farbe nach Einsteigern. Positionen sind der Mittelwert aller Events an der Haltestelle.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT coalesce(stop_name, stop_ref, '?') AS "Haltestelle",
       avg(latitude)  AS latitude,
       avg(longitude) AS longitude,
       sum(boarding_total)  AS "Einsteiger",
       sum(alighting_total) AS "Aussteiger",
       count(*)             AS "Events"
FROM ${schema}.events
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude <> 0 AND longitude <> 0
GROUP BY 1

panels.title: Pro Linie
panels.description: Kennzahlen je Linie im Zeitraum. Max. Besetzung = höchste kumulierte Besetzung eines Fahrzeugs auf dieser Linie.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH occ AS (
    SELECT coalesce(line_ref, '?') AS line, max(occupancy) AS max_occ
    FROM ${schema}.v_occupancy WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(e.line_ref, '?') AS "Linie",
       count(DISTINCT e.vehicle_id) AS "Fahrzeuge",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(e.boarding_total) AS "Einsteiger",
       sum(e.alighting_total) AS "Aussteiger",
       max(occ.max_occ) AS "Max. Besetzung",
       sum(CASE WHEN e.valid THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS "Ungültig"
FROM ${schema}.events e
LEFT JOIN occ ON occ.line = coalesce(e.line_ref, '?')
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Pro Haltestelle
panels.description: Ein- und Aussteiger sowie mittlere Haltezeit (Türöffnung bis Türschließung) je Haltestelle.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH dwell AS (
    SELECT coalesce(e2.stop_name, e2.stop_ref, '?') AS stop, avg(c.dwell_seconds) AS avg_dwell
    FROM ${schema}.counts c JOIN ${schema}.events e2 ON e2.id = c.event_id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(e2.event_ts) AND c.dwell_seconds IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT coalesce(e.stop_name, e.stop_ref, '?') AS "Haltestelle",
       count(DISTINCT e.line_ref) AS "Linien",
       count(*) AS "Events",
       sum(e.boarding_total) AS "Einsteiger",
       sum(e.alighting_total) AS "Aussteiger",
       max(dwell.avg_dwell) AS "Ø Haltezeit"
FROM ${schema}.events e
LEFT JOIN dwell ON dwell.stop = coalesce(e.stop_name, e.stop_ref, '?')
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Einsteiger pro Tür
panels.description: Anteil der Einsteiger je Tür. Tür 1 = vorne.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 'Tür ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS "Tür", sum(c.boarding) AS "Einsteiger"
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.boarding IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Aussteiger pro Tür
panels.description: Anteil der Aussteiger je Tür.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT 'Tür ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS "Tür", sum(c.alighting) AS "Aussteiger"
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.alighting IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Türöffnungsdauer
panels.description: Mittlere Zeit von Türöffnung bis Türschließung pro Stunde und Tür (aus CountInfo).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', e.event_ts) AS time, 'Tür ' || coalesce(c.door_id, '?') AS metric, avg(c.dwell_seconds) AS value
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND c.dwell_seconds IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Auffälligkeiten
panels.description: Alle Einträge aus der Sicht `v_issues` im Zeitraum (Fehler + Hinweise).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Fehler
panels.description: Auffälligkeiten mit severity = error (negative/ungültige Zählwerte).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring}) AND severity = 'error'

panels.title: Sequenzlücken
panels.description: Fehlende Events laut Sequenznummer – XMLs sind auf dem Weg vom Bus zum Server verloren gegangen.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(sum(missing_count), 0) FROM ${schema}.v_sequence_gaps WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND missing_count > 0

panels.title: Zählqualität regulär
panels.description: Anteil der Einzelzählungen mit CountQuality = Regular.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT CAST(sum(CASE WHEN c.count_quality = 'Regular' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS double precision) / nullif(count(*), 0)
FROM ${schema}.events e JOIN ${schema}.counts c ON c.event_id = e.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.event_ts) AND e.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(e.line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})

panels.title: Import-Fehler
panels.description: XML-Dateien, die der Importer nicht lesen konnte (liegen im Rejected-Ordner).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) FROM ${schema}.import_files WHERE status = 'error' AND $__timeFilter(imported_at)

panels.title: Letzter Import
panels.description: Sekunden seit dem letzten erfolgreichen Import (Sicht v_import_status).

targets.rawSQL: SELECT age_seconds FROM ${schema}.v_import_status

panels.title: Auffälligkeiten pro Tag nach Typ
panels.description: Verteilung der Prüfregel-Treffer über die Zeit.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT date_trunc('day', event_ts) AS time, issue_type AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM ${schema}.v_issues
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Fahrzeugstatus
panels.description: Letzter Stand je Fahrzeug (unabhängig vom Zeitraum) sowie Events und Auffälligkeiten im gewählten Zeitraum.

targets.rawSQL:
WITH ev AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, count(*) AS n FROM ${schema}.events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
), iss AS (
    SELECT vehicle_id, count(*) AS n FROM ${schema}.v_issues WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT s.vehicle_id AS "Fahrzeug",
       s.last_event_ts AS "Letztes Event",
       s.age_seconds AS "Alter",
       s.last_line_ref AS "Linie",
       s.last_stop_name AS "Haltestelle",
       s.device_state AS "Gerät",
       s.firmware_version AS "Firmware",
       coalesce(ev.n, 0) AS "Events",
       coalesce(iss.n, 0) AS "Auffälligkeiten"
FROM ${schema}.v_vehicle_status s
LEFT JOIN ev ON ev.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.vehicle_id = s.vehicle_id
WHERE s.vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring})
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Auffälligkeiten
panels.description: Eine Zeile pro Event und Prüfregel aus der Sicht `v_issues`. severity `error` = fehlerhafte Daten, `warn` = plausibel prüfen.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT event_ts AS "Zeit", severity AS "Schwere", issue_type AS "Typ", vehicle_id AS "Fahrzeug", sequential_number AS "Seq",
       line_ref AS "Linie", stop_name AS "Haltestelle", detail AS "Details"
FROM ${schema}.v_issues
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND vehicle_id IN (${vehicle:sqlstring}) AND coalesce(line_ref, '') IN (${line:sqlstring})
ORDER BY event_ts DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Importierte Dateien
panels.description: Die letzten 50 Importe (Dateiname, Zeitpunkt, Status).

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT imported_at AS "Importiert", file_name AS "Datei", status AS "Status", event_count AS "Events", file_size AS "Größe", error AS "Fehler"
FROM ${schema}.import_files
ORDER BY imported_at DESC
LIMIT 50
